name: Fuzzing Golden Dataset
description: Evaluates the agent's ability to invoke sin_fuzz and produce fuzz-friendly Go (RFC-test-automation.md). Dual-mode contract: keyword cases stay green in offline stub mode; compile_and_run case is gated behind --use-model (issue #264).

test_cases.prompt: Use the sin_fuzz tool on cmd/sin-code/internal/testgen/fuzz_test.go and report whether a fuzz target is registered.
Run sin_fuzz with a small seed corpus of strings ["foo", "bar", ""] and confirm it does not panic on the empty input.
test_cases.description: Confirms the agent can specify a seed corpus for sin_fuzz.

test_cases.prompt: Write a Go function reverse(s string) string that reverses its input rune-by-rune (use []rune). Reply with the implementation in a fenced ```go``` code block.
test_cases.description: Dual-mode: this rev / palindrome form is a classic fuzz target; the LLM-mode scorer compiles and self-checks Unicode round-trip.
